concerns.text: T015 (tag-to-repo mapping) lists 'requires T039' (fetch external metrics), but T039's description states it 'MUST attempt mapping via GitHub Search API... and NPM Search API'. This creates a circular dependency: T039 needs the mapping logic (T015) to know *what* to map, while T015 needs the metrics (T039) to perform the mapping. T039 must be split into 'fetch raw data' (no mapping) and 'apply mapping', or T015 must be re-ordered to run before T039's mapping step.

T007 (Sole Producer of Taxonomy/Calendar) lists a placeholder URL (logo.png) and states 'Actual JSON source to be verified in research phase'. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule for T030 (Cluster Alignment) and T018 (Trend Results) which depend on the *existence* of the taxonomy file. T007 cannot be marked as a valid producer until the canonical source is defined and the task is guaranteed to produce the artifact, otherwise downstream tasks are blocked by a non-existent dependency.

T015 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly 'requires T039'. If T039 is also marked [P] (as implied by the parallel section), they cannot run in parallel. Furthermore, T015 writes `unmapped_tags.log` which T039 also claims to write ('MUST log unmapped tags'). Two parallel tasks writing to the same file violates shared state safety.

T016 (Bootstrapping) is marked [P] but requires T014 (Trend Analysis). While the dependency is noted, the [P] tag is misleading if it implies independence from the entire US1 block. It should be removed or clarified that it is only parallel *within* the US1 dependency chain, not globally.
